name: Sakurai (Nara, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakurai city emblem in maroon: an outlined cherry blossom of five petals.
history: Municipal flag of Sakurai, a city in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1956.

features.role: Sakurai city emblem — an outlined cherry blossom of five petals
